Subject: Invitation to Speak at [Conference Name]

Dear [Speaker Name],

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to you on behalf of [Conference Name], an upcoming event dedicated to [Event Theme]. Given your extensive expertise and thought leadership in [Speaker's Field], we believe you would be an exceptional fit for our keynote slot. Your recent work on [Specific Topic/Book/Paper] particularly resonates with our audience, and we would be honored to have you share your insights.

We are offering a speaking fee of [Amount] for your participation, which includes travel and accommodation expenses. We are flexible regarding the date and would love to discuss a time that works best for your schedule.

Please let us know if you are interested in this opportunity. We would be happy to provide more details or answer any questions you may have.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Conference Name]
[Contact Information]
